candidates.text: Boiling drinking water does not remove lead from it.
Use only cold tap water for drinking, cooking, and preparing baby formula. Hot water can carry more lead from pipes and fixtures.
An earthquake has one magnitude measuring its size at the source; the value does not depend on where it is measured.
Earthquake intensity describes shaking at a particular place and can differ between locations for the same event.
A tornado watch means tornadoes are possible in or near the watch area; prepare to act if a warning follows.
A tornado warning means a tornado is occurring or imminent in the warned area, so take shelter immediately.
Two MMR vaccine doses are about 97 percent effective at preventing measles.
One MMR vaccine dose is about 93 percent effective against measles.
